title: Tokyo Eye
valueStatement: Poincaré GNN and MoE structural inference on a FastAPI / pgvector control plane, with Terraform data infra and MLflow gates.
architectureHighlight: 20-tool LLM coordinator, JWT sessions, provenance_run writes, and property-gate CI — agents stay inside the open structure.
description: A governed scientific-AI platform for structural inference and ligand–protein work. Core science is PyTorch hyperbolic GNNs (geoopt), SE(3) via e3nn, MoE routing, and evidential uncertainty, plus GUDHI/RDKit/OpenMM. That sits on FastAPI (JWT, 20-tool coordinator, Bedrock→Anthropic→Mock), PostgreSQL 16 / pgvector with a single-write-path dimensional model and provenance_run lineage, Terraform Aurora+S3, and MLflow/Optuna with property-gate CI. The Poincaré visualizer uses XState machines for viewport, discovery phase, and hypothesis lifecycle — not a disconnected chatbot.
pitch: Poincaré GNN and MoE structural inference on a FastAPI / pgvector control plane, with Terraform data infra and MLflow gates.
challenge: Scientific assistants fail when they sit next to the work instead of in it — inventing plausible chemistry, ignoring the open structure, and leaving no provenance. Tokyo Eye had to bind agents to the current graph, selected residues, and preregistered metric gates, and keep geometry, data, and session state on one governed write path.
development: Built the platform in tokyo-eye-agenticpoincare. Science extra: PyTorch/PyG, geoopt Poincaré, e3nn SE(3), GUDHI TDA, MoE routing, evidential heads, RDKit, OpenMM, PDB/dehydron ingestion. Agent: FastAPI, JWT, rate-limited sessions, WebSocket viewport directives, 20-tool coordinator, Bedrock → Anthropic → Mock, hypothesis + literature tools. Data: pgvector hyperbolic similarity, 30-schema migrations local↔Aurora, dimensional model, single-write-path normalizer, provenance_run. Infra: Terraform Aurora+S3, MLflow+Optuna, property-gate CI (corpus/smoke/curv). Visualizer: three XState machines (viewport, discovery phase, hypothesis lifecycle) — an earlier card audit that said XState was spec-only was wrong; eidetix-bio is a separate Three.js dehydron viewer. G12D is a separate OpenMM KRAS app. MLflow smoke proves schema emission; multi-stage lineage is still pending in-repo.
outcome: Private source of truth is tokyo-eye-agenticpoincare. Public research showcase is hgnn-protein-ligand. This static portfolio hosts Discovery Story and Discovery Cockpit as HTML walkthroughs — not the FastAPI/XState visualizer. Findings docs include abandoned claims as well as surviving physics; unproven capability stays labeled unproven.

journey.title: Put AI in the scientist’s actual context

journey.title: Hyperbolic geometry as the spatial prior
journey.description: Poincaré / geoopt embeddings so hierarchical residue, fragment, and pocket structure stay continuous instead of flattening into a Euclidean bag of atoms.

journey.title: Versioned science, not a frozen miss
journey.description: DTIE v3–v6 live in tree. Production inference is the V5 GNN path; training continues on v6 with MLflow governance. MoE and e3nn are in the science extra, not a slide overlay.

journey.title: One write path, then the agent
journey.description: All data writes go through the normalizer. provenance_run is recorded before results. The 20-tool coordinator cannot skip that contract.

journey.title: Session machine vs portfolio HTML
journey.description: XState owns the React Poincaré dashboard in the platform repo. Discovery Story and Cockpit on this site are static walkthroughs of how a finding is supposed to feel when the system is honest.

specs.description: gates.yml property tests (corpus / smoke / curvature). Findings markdown records abandoned claims (λ₂ as cancer discriminator) alongside surviving dehydron physics.
